site_name: Aligned Salt Lake City SLC-01, 3333 West 9000 South, West Jordan, UT 84088
year_evidence_quote: The company has operational data center facilities in Dallas, Phoenix, and Salt Lake City
year_site_match: Aligned's Salt Lake facility is its West Jordan campus: the March 2018 release announces the Salt Lake City-area development in West Jordan (300,000 sq ft building), the October 2019 release calls it the existing 34 MW, 300,000 sq ft West Jordan data center, and Aligned's location page lists SLC-01 and SLC-02 at 3333 W 9000 S, West Jordan, UT 84088. It is Aligned's only Salt Lake area campus.
verification: The researcher's year (2018) holds, but not on the cited page: the trade-press article (2018-03-23) and Aligned's own announcement (dateline 2018-03-20) are forward-looking (building being renovated, completion that summer, 3Q 2018 commissioning). The supporting evidence is Aligned's financing release with dateline DALLAS (Sept. 25, 2018), which lists Salt Lake City among its operational facilities (the quote is the first clause of a longer sentence). Together the two operator releases pin first operation between 2018-03-20 and 2018-09-25, inside one calendar year. Corroboration: Aligned's 2019-01-30 release reports the Salt Lake City data center received Uptime's M&O Stamp of Approval, and the October 2019 release calls the West Jordan data center existing. Caveats: the September 2018 sentence is company-description language in a financing release, not an opening announcement, and none of the 2018 pages gives the street address. SLC-02's completion was announced in the March 2021 release, consistent with the researcher's second phase.

lead.year_evidence_quote: When completed this summer, the facility will provide a 50 megawatt data center in the suburb of West Jordan
lead.notes: Multiple aggregators (Cleanview, Baxtel) cite 2018 as operational year. March 2018 announcement said facility would be completed summer 2018. Former Fairchild Semiconductor facility converted to data center. SLC-02 opened March 2021 on same campus per Baxtel.

site_name: Aligned IAD-01, 21890 Uunet Drive, Ashburn, VA 20147
year_evidence_quote: ASHBURN, VA – SEPTEMBER 16, 2019 – ... announces the completion of phase one of its hyperscale data center campus in Ashburn, Virginia.
verification: Confirmed at the first check, which opened the cited page. Aligned press release 'Aligned Completes Phase One of Ashburn Data Center Campus', subhead 'First Phase of Capacity Delivered and Formal Commissioning Underway at the Hyperscale Campus'; first 12 MW and two data halls built out. Supports delivery in 2019. Caveats: the release gives no street address and does not use the label IAD-01; site identity rests on it being Aligned's Ashburn campus, described as 'less than 800 feet from the original UUNET-managed MAE East Exchange', which is consistent with 21890 Uunet Drive (inference, not stated on the page). Commissioning was described as underway, not finished, at the release date.

lead.year_evidence_quote: ASHBURN, VA – SEPTEMBER 16, 2019 – Aligned, a leading provider of infrastructure solutions for the hyperscale marketplace, announces the completion of phase one
lead.notes: Official Aligned press release dated September 16, 2019 announcing Phase One completion at Ashburn campus. Located on 26 acres in Data Center Alley. Spec sheet confirms 60 MW capacity, 370,000 sq ft.
